from collections import deque

def bf(planet1, planet2):
    # Check if both planet names are valid
    if planet1 not in ["Mercury", "Venus", "Earth", "Mars", "Jupiter", "Saturn", "Uranus"]:
        return ()
    
    # Initialize a deque with the list of planets
    dq = deque(["Mercury", "Venus", "Earth", "Mars", "Jupiter", "Saturn", "Uranus"])
    
    # Add planet1 to the front of the deque
    dq.appendleft(planet1)
    
    # Add planet2 to the back of the deque
    dq.append(planet2)
    
    # Sort the planets based on their proximity to the sun
    dq.sort()
    
    # Extract the planets from the deque in reverse order
    result = []
    while dq:
        result.append(dq.pop())
        
    return tuple(result)

def list_sort(lst: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    # Filter out words longer than 2 characters
    filtered_lst = [word for word in lst if len(word) > 2]
    
    # Sort the filtered list by length of words in descending order
    sorted_lst = sorted(filtered_lst, key=lambda x: (-len(x), x))
